bio.short: I lead product design at Bibel TV and turn AI concepts into working software. I prototype with Claude Code against real APIs. I own a conversational Bible study app across product, design and agentic development. I also shipped Selah, a Mac app I designed and agentically engineered. Before this I led teams at Ninox and the UX team within Datameer's design organisation.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV I lead product design across iOS, Android, web and connected TV. I also hold product responsibility for the app redesign. I prototype new experiences with Claude Code against real and self-built APIs. The external engineering agency works from those running prototypes. I own a Conversational AI Bible Study App in development across product direction, interface design and agentic development. I also shipped a Microsoft Copilot skill for viewer support whose replies remain under staff control.

My independent practice carries the same builder track. I designed and agentically engineered Selah - Mindful Transitions, a Mac app shipped through the Mac App Store. In summer 2025 I worked with Ninox's CEO and technical co-founder on conversational prompt-to-database onboarding. AI generates the schema, then displays it in the real editor beside chat. The user can inspect and change it directly.

I have also led teams and design systems. At Ninox I managed five people across product design and UX writing. I hired two, promoted two and owned the design system with joint engineering governance. At Datameer I led the UX team across Germany and New York for enterprise analytics. The throughline is hands-on product craft paired with structures that help other designers and engineers move faster.

context.emphasis: Lead with working AI software, conversational interaction, real-code prototyping, user control and the ability to coach a design practice. Keep current Bibel TV products explicitly in development where applicable; use Selah as shipped independent-product proof.
